text:
anya: kinda in shock 1 — got promoted to Sr PM and also brought home a foster pup tonight??!! :tada: :paw_prints:
rafael: WHAT a week. congrats on both!! pictures please :dog:
anya: meet mocha (link) 1 month old, tiny, very loud. also email from manager confirming promo. still processing.
priya: omg mocha is adorable. we should do a surprise care package + mini-celebration when youre in office next. snacks + puppy treats? :package:
emma: I can assemble a care box with treats, a blanket, and a toy. also cupcakes?
people-ops-bot: Promo logged: Anya promoted to Senior PM. Swag tier unlocked. $125 celebratory budget allocated.
anya: you dont have to do anything huge. puppy is foster-to-adopt pending vet checks. would love a tiny welcome when im in next Tuesday.
rafael: Tuesday it is. poll: :cupcake: lunch sweets or :tea: afternoon tea + puppy cuddles? react to vote.
priya: :cupcake: (bringing dairy-free option)
emma: :tea: i vote for puppy cuddles in the afternoon, then cupcakes? both?
shipping-bot: Care package order ready for pickup at 11:30 (organizer: emma). Tracking: TRK12345.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Anya promo + Mocha welcome" Tue 15:00-15:30 Kitchen Island. Zoom included for remote folks.
rafael: whos bringing a camera for puppy photos? i volunteer.
anya: thank you all. honestly this team slays at celebrating. also mocha says hi (and immediately knocked over a plant).
emma (reaction): :heart: (added by emma)
priya (reaction): :tada: (added by priya)
